page.overview:
Who is Okuyasu Nijimura?

[http://www.mausu.net/talent/tpdb_view.cgi?UID=230 Konami Saitō] (Anime Child ver.)

Introduced as an antagonist, Okuyasu soon becomes Josuke Higashikata's best friend. They stay close friends throughout Part 4 and tackle malevolent Stand users together.

He is also Keicho Nijimura's little brother and also a Stand User wielding the fearsome "The Hand".

Okuyasu is a young man of above-average height and medium to athletic build.
